name: preferences.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  preferences.scss — MANIFEST for the preferences dialog (shadow-scoped
//  via ?inline). Split by surface into preferences/ partials (imported
//  below):
//    _dialog        host display, backdrop, genie-zoom panel, header
//    _close         circular WebGL close button + canvas
//    _body          sections, option grids, theme slider/canvas, stats
//    _flag-options  option icons — flag canvas/img/split, labels
//    _switch        toggle switch rows
//    _footer        footer + done button + pref-fade transitions
//  Layered above the nav menu overlay.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

@import 'preferences/dialog';
@import 'preferences/close';
@import 'preferences/body';
@import 'preferences/flag-options';
@import 'preferences/switch';
@import 'preferences/footer';
